scientific_integrity: The infinite-parameter classification and weak-convergence law are proved symbolically; finite enumeration independently corroborates all coefficients in sizes 2 through 10. No publication or independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns nondecreasing full contractions and centralizers of rank-(n-1) elements only; the idempotent boundary cardinality is already covered in prior work. Earlier implicit formulations are possible. Computational checks are finite and there is no independent mathematical audit.
title: Rank-refined centralizers of corank-one contractions of a finite chain
